notes.title: b0.16 pre7
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an improved box respawn animation.
[*] Made boxes' horizontal momentum reset upon respawn.
[*] Made Level 3.10 less laggy.
[*] Made respawning boxes unable to be moved.
[*] [b]pre6 / iOS v1.0.3 [12-21-24]:[/b] [i]New respawn animation testing.[/i]
[*] Drastically reduced the intensity of the rain effect.
[*] Updated the Short Player's particle distance.
[*] Ensured level bounds are not visible on devices with irregular aspsct ratios.
[*] Added a fade animation to the splash screen.
[*] Made all canvases respect width instead of height when using a low aspect ratio.
[*] Fixed UI anchor points for instructional banners.
[*] Made the camera size update on scene load to accomodate screens with low aspect ratios.
[*] [b]pre7 / iOS v1.0.4 [2/22/2025]:[/b] [i]Happy new year. Enhanced the mobile experience.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: b0.16 pre5
notes.content:
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*]     Added particles to player landing.
[*]     Added a sound effect for hitting the ceiling.
[*]     Made music tracks not break when their tracks are desynced.
[*]     Added a toggle in Settings to turn off sound effects.
[*]     Implemented the revised Chapter 1 Theme.
[*]     Implemented the revised Title Theme.
[*]     Implemented stream controls through UDP broadcasts.
[*]     Added particles when a box lands and hits the ceiling.
[*]     Added a sound effect when a box hits the ceiling.
[*]     Made Level 4.6 less pointless (after being made pointless by a change in jump height).
[*]     Made External Magnet particles not appear in the goal's radius.
[*]     Added backgrounds for several chapters and reworked the screen effects animations.
[*]     [b]pre5 [12-14-24]:[/b] [i]Particle testing, new music testing, and bugfixes.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: b0.16 pre4
notes.content:
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*]     Made the mobile control buttons less obtrusive by scaling with height instead of width.
[*]     Made saving utilize a .json file instead of PlayerPrefs.
[*][b]     pre1 [9-2-24]:[/b] [i]New save system testing.[/i]
[*][b]     iOS v1.0.0 [9-14-24]: [/b][i]Initial App Store release.[/i]
[*]     Added a drum hit when landing.
[*]     Added a Collectible post-processing and music layer.
[*][b]     pre2 [9-26-24]:[/b] [i]New sounds testing.[/i]
[*]     Made level titles scale with height instead of width.
[*]     Animated level title entrance and exit.
[*]     Made the camera zoom in when a level restarts because a box was destroyed along with a slowdown.
[*]     Made the game pause when the windows loses focus.
[*][b]     pre3 / iOS v1.0.1 [10-2-24]:[/b] [i]New animations testing.[/i]
[*]     Added a rain effect to Chapter 3.
[*]     Updated the Android icon.
[*]     Refined and expanded on the rain effect.
[*]     Tweaked the player land sound.
[*]     Made the continue button always greyed out if there is no save data.
[*][b]     pre4 [10-4-24]:[/b] [i]Android and rain testing.[/i]
[/list]
